selection_scope.applies_to: RQ2 Gradient Descent fixed P0/P1 baseline classification only
selection_scope.explanation: Frozen Contract semantics remain authoritative, but RQ1 generation requirements do not define the RQ2 lesson scope. This file classifies the fixed P0/P1 target backbone; P2 performs learner-specific selection from the Frozen Curriculum Model and does not use this file as selection authority.
selection_scope.confirmatory_requirement: Receive supervisor or curriculum review together with the learning request, canonical pathway, and normalization map before confirmatory generation.

classification_notes: Universal core denotes the target backbone of the fixed P0/P1 baseline, not a universal content requirement imposed on P2.
Every selected item remains governed by the released Frozen Reference Contract.
P2 must decide all thirty Contract items from the shared learning request, learner profile, and Frozen Curriculum Model.
Released prerequisite bridges may supply missing external prerequisites but may not duplicate or expand selected Contract target content.

common_learning_outcomes.statement: Formulate a differentiable unconstrained optimisation problem, identify first-order stationarity, and apply the gradient-descent update.
Relate smoothness and descent bounds to constant and backtracking step-size choices.
Interpret convex and strongly convex convergence results and the effect of conditioning.
Trace or express the selected update and step-selection rules as an algorithm without extending their guarantees.
